encounter.title: Act I Encounter 3 — Square Candidate B (7x7 seed 25)
encounter.notes: LD-003 square shortlist candidate B for Act I #3. 7x7 seed 25 (12 arrows: N3 E3 S2 W4). Retains the iconic seed number 25. Caster N (hp 3, CAST IN 3 dmg 4, interruptible); Grunt E (hp 2, ATTACK IN 4 dmg 2). Tapping #0(W) unlocks #11(E), which in turn unlocks #1(N) to interrupt the Caster exactly on step 3 before the cast fires. Then #10(E), #3(N), #4(N) complete the fight with 0 damage in 6 taps. Missing the interrupt punishes with damage.
